item.title: Federal Reserve Raises Interest Rates for First Time Since 2023; Markets Rally
item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter of a percentage point, the first increase since July 2023, setting the federal funds rate at a range of 3.75% to 4.00%. item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman; son Howard named successor
item.description: Warren Buffett, the 96-year-old legendary investor who built Berkshire Hathaway into a $1 trillion conglomerate, stepped down as chairman on Friday, effective immediately, and was named chairman emeritus while remaining a director.
